query:
WITH driver_ids_over_25 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
    WHERE is_in_population = TRUE
      AND occupation_description = 'سائق خاص'
      AND age > 25
), 

violations_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.gdate_happened) AS violation_year,
        COUNT(*) AS total_violations
    FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation tv
    JOIN driver_ids_over_25 d ON tv.violator_id = d.id
    WHERE tv.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.gdate_happened) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.gdate_happened)
),

driver_counts_by_year AS (
    SELECT 
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.gdate_happened) AS violation_year,
        COUNT(DISTINCT tv.violator_id) AS distinct_drivers
    FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation tv
    JOIN driver_ids_over_25 d ON tv.violator_id = d.id
    WHERE tv.status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.gdate_happened) BETWEEN 2021 AND 2025
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM tv.gdate_happened)
)

SELECT 
    v.violation_year AS "العام",
    ROUND(v.total_violations * 1.0 / d.distinct_drivers, 2) AS "متوسط المخالفات السنوية للسائقين فوق 25 سنة"
FROM violations_by_year v
JOIN driver_counts_by_year d ON v.violation_year = d.violation_year
ORDER BY v.violation_year LIMIT 20000;
raw_question: ما الفرق بالنسبة المئوية في متوسط عدد المخالفات السنوية بين السائقين تحت عمر  25 سنة وفوق عمر 25 ...
